title: Account History Rule: Repeat Cancellation Charge on Delivery & Pickup Services Orders
content:
When a Delivery & Pickup Services order is cancelled before dispatch, the repeat cancellation charge retained depends on the orders cancelled at the patient's request on the plan in the 6 months up to today, the cancelled order included. The repeat cancellation charge retained is kept back from the refund of the cancelled order's speed fee.

## Rule

| Orders cancelled at the patient's request on the plan in the 6 months up to today | Repeat cancellation charge retained |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | $1.50 |
| exactly 2 | $0.75 |
| a single one, or none | none |

Only cancellations at the patient's request are counted; cancellations for an unavailable item or an address outside the delivery area are not.

## Hypothetical histories

| Cancellation history on the plan, last 6 months | Count | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| this order only, cancelled at the patient's request | 1 | none |
| this order and one earlier, both at the patient's request | 2 | $0.75 |
| this order and three earlier, all at the patient's request | 4 | $1.50 |
| this order at the patient's request, one earlier for an unavailable item | 1 | none |
| this order at the patient's request, one at the patient's request 7 months ago | 1 | none |
